body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Sony present its Blu-ray Disc home theater system 'BDV-E770W' at CES2010, which features 5.1-channel surround sound and wireless rear speakers. Suggested price is $649.99.
